description: Use this when the user asks for an example schedule of a wedding day. Zola's general wedding day timeline template, from the guest arrival to the farewell, moved to the given ceremony time. The example day starts 1 hour before the ceremony and ends 5 hours after it, so the ceremony time must be from 07:00 to 19:00. Do not use for the tasks of the months before the wedding (use zola_get_planning_timeline_template). Do not use for the couple's own events and their times: use zola_list_my_wedding_events.
name: zola_get_wedding_day_timeline_template

events.description: The events of the wedding day, in time order

time.description: Start time, HH:MM, 24-hour. 24:00 is midnight at the end of the day

source.description: The Zola article that gives these values

title: Get Wedding Day Timeline Template
